quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil expands its role in major Brazilian power plant (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Order (release): Wärtsilä broadened its role in seven power plant projects for Brazilian energy company Origem Energia (Pilar Nova, Pilar and Manguaba I-V, Northeastern Brazil) from engine supply to also include process engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) above ground level; the equipment contracts were booked in Q1 and Q2 2026 and the EPC order in Q3 2026. The plants, awarded in Brazil's 2026 Reserve Capacity Auction, total 371 MW of flexible capacity using 36 Wärtsilä 34SG balancing engines; Pilar Nova and Pilar are scheduled for commercial operation in October 2028 and Manguaba I-V in August 2029.
quarterly_data.figure: 371 MW; 36 Wärtsilä 34SG engines; EPC order booked Q3 2026
